games.name: [BETA] Ranger Emergency
games.description:
Aquatica Calling all units! 

**NOTE : THIS EXPERIENCE IS CURRENTLY IN BETA! THERE WILL BE BUGS!**

Join the Everglades Park Rangers and compete with others to protect our beautiful park from wildfires, hazardous spills, invasive species, and other environmental emergencies. Respond to calls across a vast national park, operate rescue vehicles, and work together with other players to save lives and restore damaged ecosystems!

🔥| Fight spreading wildfires
🦌| Rescue and relocate injured wildlife
⚠️| Respond to hazardous material incidents

❓| How To Play:
Step 1: Join a match
Step 2: Spawn your vehicle
Step 3: Respond to the emergency
Step 4: Get the highest environmental score!

This experience is not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Park Service or any government agency.

Tags: National Parks, Firefighting, Wildland Fire, Hazmat, Emergency Response, Search and Rescue, Emergency, Park Ranger, Nature
